# agentic-image

Route image prompts across Flux, Ideogram, Replicate, and Workers AI.

Keywords: image-generation, flux, agentic-suite, claude-code, codex, cli, mcp.

- SDK: import { generateImage, listVendors } from "agentic-image".
- CLI: agentic-image generate --prompt "...".
- MCP: run agentic-image mcp, then call generate_image.
